Strategy: Reward leftovers that fit one to two more same-size items, and penalize leftovers below half an item, keeping bins roomy enough to reuse. It may help by preserving bins that stay pairable, but may fail by hoarding loose bins that later items cannot use.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= item and r - item <= 2 * item else 0) - (25 if r - item > 0 and r - item < item / 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
